variant.title: Anti-Knight Sudoku
variant.description: Equal digits may not be separated by a chess-knight move.
rule.anti_knight_equal: A knight's move cannot contain equal digits.
rule_guide.title: Anti-Knight Sudoku Rules
rule_guide.item_1: Each row, column, and 3×3 box must contain no repeated digit.
rule_guide.item_2: Two equal digits may not be separated by a chess knight move.
